invariants.rationale: The method accesses result and its methods; therefore, result must be non-null.
getWriteStatuses() is called on result and further used; thus, it should not return null.
The code operates on each WriteStatus; thus, none should be null.
The code calls getStat() on each WriteStatus, implying none should return null.
Mapping getStat over all WriteStatus should yield a list of the same size.
